entries.en: to urge on and hold to account; to press with reproof
entries.notes: 西语栏 arrexir enserian lo 拼写异常难以对上规范西语；官话栏首音调号 T99（污損難辨），依汉字「督責」与闽、官对音定为督责义。

entries.en: to admonish gently with fair words; to coax and persuade with kind words
〔Original columns blank/damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 西语栏 Correo（信差；邮件）及互见指引 infra in principio 与闽南栏 gia quy san 可读，但汉字栏、官话栏皆空白，四栏互证不足。

entries.en: 〔Original columns blank; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 西语栏 Jn frijoles guisados（＝unos frijoles guisados，炖豆子）可读，汉字、闽南、官话三栏全空。

entries.en: to run

entries.zh: 策马疾驰；纵使马匹牲畜奔窜
entries.en: to gallop a horse; to make a horse or beast dash off
entries.notes: 汉字栏仅「竄」一字，闽南栏四音节后两音节对应汉字未明，官话栏仅录首音，四栏未完全互证。

entries.zh: 幼畜追随母畜而行；跟随
entries.en: (of a young animal) to run after its mother; to follow along
entries.notes: 汉字栏录作「淵」与西语义不合，疑形近误录「沿」（跟随），从西语栏与对音 ién 定为跟随义。

entries.en: to flow (of water); to run
water flowing broad and free; to well up and flow
entries.notes: 闽南栏首音调号 T99（污損難辨）；据「汪」字与闽、官对音定水流义。

entries.en: water spreading out in ripples
entries.notes: 西语栏 despandadve 疑为 desparramado（漫流四散）之污损拼写；闽南栏末音调号 T99。

entries.en: to gallop; (of a horse) to speed along
to drive or spur on a horse; to urge an animal forward
to gallop at full speed; to dash along
to scurry off; to run away in haste
entries.notes: 官话栏次音调号 T99（污損難辨）；竄、走二字与闽、官对音相合，定为奔逃义。

entries.zh: 字面作「浪去」（浪荡而去）；四栏不合，释义存疑
entries.en: literal reading of the characters ('to drift off'); columns do not corroborate — gloss uncertain
entries.notes: 西语栏 ringararade 非规范西语，汉字仅二字而闽、官各三音节且官话 hàng 无对应汉字，语义无法定夺。

entries.en: to run off; to run away
entries.notes: 汉字「泡」疑为「跑」之形近（官话 pâu 与跑音合）；官话栏次音调号 T99（污損難辨）。

entries.zh: 拴缚马匹（汉字栏义）；西语栏作策马奔驰，两栏有出入
entries.en: to tether or bind the horse (Chinese column); Spanish column reads 'to run/charge the horse' — columns diverge
entries.notes: 汉字「縛馬」与西语 correr al cavallo 义不合，疑原稿串行或误书，以汉字栏为主并注明出入。

entries.en: to run in haste; to hurry off
entries.notes: 汉字栏带 [疑:僕/促] 标记；西语栏 a piessa 疑为 apriesa/a prisa（急速）之拼写，与促走义相合。

entries.en: to run on ahead; to push past in front
entries.notes: 官话栏次音调号 T99（污損難辨）；「做頭行」（抢先走路）与西语 pasando adelante 相合。

entries.zh: 行船冒风浪之险；在海上历险（舵、风、水并举）
entries.en: to run risks at sea; to brave wind and water
entries.notes: 闽南栏「水」音调号 T99（污損難辨）；舵、风、水三字与西语 correr riesgo en el mar 义合。

entries.zh: 行船冒风浪之险；在海上历险（舵、风、涌并举）
entries.en: to run risks at sea; to brave wind and waves
to roam the world; to travel about

entries.zh: 凶猛奔逃；仓皇夺路而去
